lines.en:
It's been far too long since I've ventured this far into the edges of the frozen abyss.  Fort Rittenbach. A monument of our heritage, and to our survival... still it stands.
There, the Sayunaari seem to have fortified a central position within the fortress.  I must wonder, why? Their reputation as such strident warriors, against these... petty bandits?  No matter. Army of Embor, we shall rid Fort Rittenbach of these invaders and return Donar's glory to this place.
You...  you must be the lord of these lands.  Duke Jaromir?
lines.zh: 你…… 你一定就是这片土地的领主吧。 贾洛米公爵？

lines.en: Donar's mercy...  Y-yes, and I am afraid you have me at a disadvantage, for I do not know your name.
lines.zh: 多纳尔保佑…… 是、是的，恐怕我是处于不利地位了，因为我还不知道你的名字。

lines.en: Ragavi, General of the Sayunaari Defense Army of Dakur.  We owe you our lives. But I am afraid all we may have done nothing but doom you alongside all of us.
lines.zh: 拉加维，萨育纳达库尔守军的将军。 我们欠您救命之恩。但恐怕我们能做的只有连累你们一同遭受灭顶之灾。

lines.en: Honored, General Ragavi of the Sayunaari. I'm afraid you owe us nothing, for surely this rabble was no threat to you...
lines.zh: 我很荣幸，萨育纳将军拉加维。恐怕你们欠不了我们什么，这群乌合之众肯定威胁不到你们吧……

lines.en: No...  here they come once again! Steel yourselves, Emborians!
lines.zh: 不…… 他们又来了！准备应战，恩博尔人！
